agent_explanation: With dt~0.0194 (near max) and sensor_noise~0.0145, seeded noisy theta measurement corrupts state-feedback. Trace shows oscillation growing: theta 0.14 at step10, 0.47 at step20, then rapid fall to -0.62 at step33 and -0.85 at step34 with omega -12.3 rad/s and v 7.5 m/s, controller force ~22-37N chasing noise. Removing noise alone stabilizes the run, proving noise-induced loss of stabilizing phase margin at coarse sampling is the cause.
